## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the minimal solution.

## Contract and security impact

- Affected graph, API, runtime, storage, data, or network boundaries:
- Why the change remains local-first and fail-closed:

## Verification

List the focused checks and full checks that were run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing repository patterns.
- [ ] Behavior changes include meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Directly affected documentation and synthetic fixtures are updated.
- [ ] Unknown or unsupported facts remain explicitly `Unresolved`.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, real analyzed-project data, source excerpts, absolute local roots, generated artifacts, or logs are included.
- [ ] TLS, loopback, capability, persistence, and external-boundary protections are not weakened.
